notes.title: Paradise v1.2
notes.content:
Changelog v1.2

[list]
[*] Added basic guns and ammo
[*] Made ADS zooming faster
[*] Added projectile hit cloud
[*] Fixed bug where you can drag empty items into containers
[*] Fixed ragdoll bug
[*] Added gamemode in server browser
[*] Made meat heal 60 HP rather than 20
[*] Added loot crate when players die
[*] Added above-head nametags
[*] Fixed container stacking bug
[*] Fixed fence crafting recipe
[*] Added dune buggies
[*] Added guardian attack animation
[*] Increased guardian sensing
[*] Nerfed wolves by 40 HP
[*] Added basic sounds to enemies
[*] Added kill command
[*] Added new lore elements
[*] Added a few new sound effects
[/list]

notes.title: Paradise v1.1
notes.content:
Changelog v1.1

[list]
[*] Added 2 new slots to inventory for more carry capacity
[*] Fixed connection bug after leaving a session
[*] Added chest item for even more storage
[*] Fixed bug where you couldn't craft items in full inventory
[*] Fixed crafting menu getting stuck open when building
[*] Added more delay to the player hand rotation
[*] Fixed double item placement bug
[*] Added attenuation to jump landing sound
[*] Added server config so players can customize matches
[*] Scattered scavenger hunt objects around the island
[*] Got rid of "Crafting..." on items you can't actually craft
[*] Added icons and backgrounds to dragged items
[*] First aid kits buffed to +50HP, bandages nerfed to +15HP
[*] Added console and optimization tools
[*] Removed clothes line object, replaced with fence
[*] Made it so transmitter is visibly placed at radio tower
[*] Added icons in crafting menu for easier crafting
[*] Added icon for camp fire item

[/list]
